messages:
Maya (People Ops): Quick Q — trying to add my 25yo child as a dependent. They have an IEP and are on SSI/disabled since childhood. Are they eligible to stay on medical and LTD? What docs do you need?
Amelia P.: Generally adult dependents can stay if they are disabled and were disabled prior to age 26. But carrier rules vary. Did your child live with you and are you their primary financial support?
Maya (People Ops): Yes, lives with me full-time, I claim them as dependent on taxes and pay most expenses.
Kaitlin (People Ops): OK that helps. For enrollment we need: SSN (if available), birth certificate, proof of disability (SSA disability award letter preferred OR a current physician letter on letterhead), and proof of dependency (most recent tax return or proof of financial support + a residency doc like a utility bill).
Kaitlin (People Ops): For LTD specifically, carriers often require the dependent to be covered under the medical plan first. Also LTD continuation for dependents varies — sometimes there's an age cap unless disability started earlier. We'll confirm with the LTD carrier.
Maya (People Ops): Is there a template for the physician letter?
Kaitlin (People Ops): Yes — short note saying onset date, diagnosis, and statement that they are incapable of self-support and need ongoing care. If you want I can paste the example.
Kaitlin (People Ops): Example:
```
Dr. Name
Practice name, address
Date
To whom it may concern:
Patient: <name>, DOB: <mm/dd/yyyy>
Diagnosis: <primary dx>
Onset: <mm/yyyy or "since childhood">
Statement: Patient has a chronic disability and is substantially limited in performing major life activities; patient requires ongoing support and is not capable of self-support.
Sincerely,
Dr. Name, MD
```
Amelia P.: Also confirm the timing — is this a QLE or are you doing during open enrollment? If QLE, we can do midyear enrollment with docs.
Maya (People Ops): Need to add now — just had updated documentation. Is there a secure place to upload?
Kaitlin (People Ops): Please submit to benefits@redwood.com with subject: "Dependent Enrollment — [Your Name]", attach all docs as PDFs. Mark if you need a QLE. We will redact and send to carrier.
Kaitlin (People Ops): Note on payroll: if added mid-pay-period we prorate premiums — payroll will handle deduction start date after carrier effective date.
BenefitsBot: Reminder: Carrier turnaround is ~7–14 business days after receipt of complete docs. If carrier requests more info we will ping you.
Raj S.: If you prefer, I can help scan and PDF the IEP and physician letter later today.
Maya (People Ops): That would be amazing, thanks Raj. Anything else I should know?
Kaitlin (People Ops): One more item — if SSA letter is pending, the physician letter + tax return is usually enough to initiate enrollment, but the carrier may require final SSA approval later. We'll note it on the submission.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll gather and send this afternoon. :pray:
